scope: R2 supersedes the unrun R1 preparation without changing its files. It combines ordinary norms, actual-token fusion inputs, prompt K/V, Q/RoPE and both residual norm output modes. Expected norm/rotary values are original GB10 observations. Rounded residual expectations are independent CPU formulas over captured operands, not separately captured buffers. The prompt-cache owner is compiled through the probe include closure, but its HIP projection callback and complete inference are not exercised. Dispatch requires the active full256k process to have completed and passed final cleanup checks.
